serie: Loretta's Church Kitchen: an 81-year-old Iowa church lady shares the church supper recipes of her little cookbook, one trick per recipe, in her own voice
acciones: stirring a pot, sliding a 9x13 pan into the oven, lifting a lid, tasting from a wooden spoon, carrying a covered dish, setting a church supper table, pressing dough balls into a pan, spooning sauce over a ham
estilo: One ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by her grandson with a phone at eye level, in the middle of the action: framing casual and a little off, something cut by the edge of the frame, almost everything in focus and nothing blurred out, only the light the place really has (a ceiling bulb, a lamp or the daylight from the window), automatic white balance a bit off, slight phone noise, ordinary worn objects of an old Iowa farmhouse, plain bottles and rags with no labels, no beautiful composition.

loretta.desc: Loretta, an 81-year-old white American grandmother with short curly snow-white hair, thin wire-rimmed glasses, a lilac button-up blouse, a small pearl necklace and a faded floral cotton apron, with old wrinkled hands

lugares_fijos.cocina: Loretta's farmhouse kitchen: a white enamel stove with chrome handles, yellow gingham curtains on the window, a worn wooden table, a wall calendar, a rooster cookie jar on the counter
lugares_fijos.sotano: the basement kitchen of Zion United Methodist church: long folding tables with white paper, big metal stockpots on a steel counter, a row of aluminum roasters, a serving window, a bulletin board with a hand-lettered sign-up sheet
lugares_fijos.mesa: a church supper table in a fellowship hall: long folding tables covered in white paper, casserole dishes with foil, a plate of deviled eggs, a glass bowl of salad

identidad: Preserve the exact identity, face, short curly snow-white hair, thin wire-rimmed glasses, age and skin of the elderly woman in the reference photograph. She wears a lilac button-up blouse, a small pearl necklace and a faded floral cotton apron.
